reviewed_by: Automated static review, 2026-10-23 (Binary Ninja MCP, Radare2 6.2.0, angr 10.0.4.post1 CFGFast) against retail igi.exe and the current retail_main.cpp
scope: Single-instance mutex creation, the three duplicate-instance/failure conditions, the shared MessageBoxA failure block, the normal-path ReleaseMutex, and the two app-context startup calls (AppContext_SetIsActive(1) at 0x0048F615 and AppContext_SetTerrainLightmapsUsed(1) at 0x0048F63D). The wider Win32 window shell is a candidate-only adaptation and is not claimed equivalent.

signature.retail: WPARAM __stdcall(HINSTANCE arg1, int32_t arg2 @ 0xc), ret 0x10, 994-byte body, 26 blocks / 37 edges
signature.candidate: int __cdecl Main(const igi::retail::core::RetailMainConfig* config), 821 bytes, 22 blocks / 31 edges
signature.note: The candidate is an ABI-adapted host entry. The mutex prefix consumes neither retail argument, so the mutex transcription is independent of the adaptation; the interfaces are not identical.

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: Binary Ninja and Radare2 both identify one function entry at 0x0048F530 and their CFG node/edge sets are identical (26 blocks, 37 edges). angr CFGFast recovers the exact entry with no unresolved jumps. The candidate Main is _Main at 0x0041FCA0 (821 bytes, 22 blocks, 31 edges) in build-clean-win32/igi1.exe; the mutex prefix is at the start of that function.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail reads the HINSTANCE at [esp+4] and the int at [esp+0xC] and returns with ret 0x10. The candidate takes one RetailMainConfig pointer and returns int. The reviewed mutex prefix and the two app-context calls read neither retail argument; the boundary difference is recorded in the record and in the structural-comparison evidence.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: Retail pushes the name pointer 0x00541ECC at 0x0048F53A; the bytes there are 49 47 49 4d 55 54 45 58 00 ("IGIMUTEX"). CreateMutexA is called at 0x0048F544 with lpMutexAttributes=0, bInitialOwner=1 and that name. GetLastError is compared with ERROR_ALREADY_EXISTS (0xB7) at 0x0048F562 and ERROR_INVALID_HANDLE (6) at 0x0048F56F. The shared failure box pushes MB_ICONERROR (0x10). The startup setters are called with the literal argument 1 (push 1 at 0x0048F613 and 0x0048F63B). The candidate reproduces each literal exactly.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Retail stores the handle at [esp+0x20] and clears [esp+0x14] at 0x0048F550; the failure block returns 0 without touching either. The candidate keeps the handle in a local and does not write it elsewhere. The startup setters only store the app-context flag through their own globals; the candidate does not add any other memory access.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: Verified order: CreateMutexA(0,1,"IGIMUTEX") at 0x0048F544; NULL-handle test at 0x0048F54A; GetLastError/0xB7 at 0x0048F560-0x0048F562; GetLastError/6 at 0x0048F56D-0x0048F56F; shared MessageBoxA at 0x0048F8F0-0x0048F8FC; normal-path ReleaseMutex at 0x0048F8CA. After RegisterClassA at 0x0048F5E6 retail pushes 1 and calls 0x0048F140 at 0x0048F613/0x0048F615 (AppContext_SetIsActive), then pushes 1 and calls 0x0048F260 at 0x0048F63B/0x0048F63D (AppContext_SetTerrainLightmapsUsed), then reaches CreateWindowExA at 0x0048F770. The candidate performs the same two stores after RegisterClassExW and before CreateWindowExW (call sites 0x0041FDD4 and 0x0041FDE0 in the linked image). The failure path neither releases nor closes the handle.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: All three retail failure conditions jump to 0x0048F8F0, which calls MessageBoxA(NULL, "IGI is already running.", "Error", MB_ICONERROR), executes xor eax,eax and ret 0x10: return 0 with no CloseHandle and no ReleaseMutex. The candidate reproduces that return and the success-path ReleaseMutex. The candidate window-creation/class-registration failure returns and the normal-loop return value differ from retail and are recorded as limitations.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: The reviewed mutex prefix and the two app-context setters perform no floating-point arithmetic. The retail FPU-control-word check is a separate block outside this scope; the candidate does not reproduce it.

review_findings: The IGIMUTEX literal, the three failure conditions, the shared MessageBoxA block, the return 0 with no CloseHandle/ReleaseMutex, and the normal-path ReleaseMutex are reproduced from the retail bytes.

The two startup app-context calls are reproduced with the retail arguments and in the retail order: SetIsActive(1) then SetTerrainLightmapsUsed(1), after class registration and before window creation.

Retail makes additional calls between the two setters that are outside this fix: push ebx(0)/call 0x0048F1A0 at 0x0048F621/0x0048F622 (debugged), push 1/call 0x0048F1C0 at 0x0048F627/0x0048F629 (debug text), push ebx(0)/call 0x0048F1E0 at 0x0048F62E/0x0048F62F (lightmaps), push 1/call 0x0048F240 at 0x0048F634/0x0048F636, and push 1/call 0x0048F120 at 0x0048F61A/0x0048F61C. The candidate does not wire them; this is recorded as a limitation, not as equivalence.
The candidate Main is ABI-adapted and its window/message-loop shell is not retail-equivalent; only the mutex prefix, the shared failure block and the two startup setters were compared.

Retail can return the WM_QUIT wParam stored at [esp+0x14] at 0x0048F8A3; the candidate returns 0. Retail normal teardown also calls SetForegroundWindow, UnregisterClassA and CoUninitialize; candidate does not.
No paired retail/candidate runtime capture exists. This review authorizes STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED only, not behavioral equivalence.
limits: Candidate entry is __cdecl with one RetailMainConfig pointer, not retail __stdcall(HINSTANCE, int) with ret 0x10; call-site compatibility is not demonstrated.
Candidate uses WNDCLASSEXW/RegisterClassExW/CreateWindowExW; retail uses WNDCLASSA/RegisterClassA/CreateWindowExA. No window-shell semantic equivalence is claimed.

Retail ignores the RegisterClassA result; candidate returns 1 when RegisterClassExW fails. Retail shows MessageBoxA(NULL, "Couldn't open window", "Innerloop", MB_ICONERROR) and returns 0 when CreateWindowExA fails; candidate returns 1 without a box.
Retail normal teardown calls SetForegroundWindow, UnregisterClassA and CoUninitialize; the candidate does not. Retail can return the WM_QUIT wParam from [esp+0x14]; candidate returns 0.

The intervening retail calls between the two app-context setters (0x0048F61C, 0x0048F622, 0x0048F629, 0x0048F62F, 0x0048F636) are not wired; only SetIsActive and SetTerrainLightmapsUsed are reproduced.

The diagnostic Win32 shell (engine/platform/windows/scene_main.cpp) has its own mutex path and never calls ReleaseMutex or CloseHandle; it relies on process exit. The reconstructed Main is not wired into the shell.
No paired retail/candidate runtime capture exists; status is capped at STRUCTURALLY_VERIFIED.
